## What this changes

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Change to an existing skill's rules (add an ADR in `decisions/`)
- [ ] Wording, examples or fixes only

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] The description says what the skill does and when to use it
- [ ] Every rule says why, in one line
- [ ] Code examples in at least two languages where code matters
